domain_inventory.source: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS) / O'Neil Commodity Consulting
domain_inventory.justification: Complete monthly continuity across all 4 macroeconomic regimes without temporal gaps.

domain_inventory.available_routes_or_locations: US to Japan (Wheat, Corn, Soybeans); India exports (Rice, Iron Ore, Ferro-chrome)
domain_inventory.monthly_modeling_sufficiency: Insufficient (< 1% timeline coverage; only 3 months in late 2024)
domain_inventory.usability_status: Excluded from C3.1 historical training sets
domain_inventory.justification: Severe historical data truncation: 367 of 370 months missing. Synthetic backfilling strictly disallowed by Pelagos integrity policy.

domain_inventory.source: NOAA National Data Buoy Center (NDBC) / INCOIS
domain_inventory.available_routes_or_locations: Buoys 46041 (Cape Elizabeth, WA), 42001 (Mid Gulf, LA), AD01 (Arabian Sea)
domain_inventory.monthly_modeling_sufficiency: Insufficient (< 0.1% coverage; isolated snapshots in 2024 and 2026)
domain_inventory.alignment_feasibility: Infeasible for multi-year historical training; deep-sea open ocean segments unmonitored
domain_inventory.usability_status: Excluded from C3.1 historical training sets
domain_inventory.justification: Moored buoys cover localized departure fairways on select dates only. Retained strictly as real-time departure water context in route intelligence.

domain_inventory.available_routes_or_locations: Buenos Aires (ARBUE), Skagen (DKSKA); corridor hubs (Seattle, Houston, Yokohama) unquoted
domain_inventory.monthly_modeling_sufficiency: Insufficient (Zero historical depth prior to November 2026)
domain_inventory.usability_status: Excluded from C3.1 historical training sets
domain_inventory.justification: Free provider feed exposes only latest spot indications. No historical time-series available. Substituting crude oil proxies (WTI, Brent) is strictly prohibited.

domain_inventory.source: UNECE UN/LOCODE, World Port Index (Pub 150), Freight Routes Catalog
domain_inventory.available_routes_or_locations: USSEA, USPDX, USHOU, USMSY, JPYOK, PNW-JPN-BULK, USG-JPN-BULK
domain_inventory.usability_status: Usable (Benchmark distance, region, and vessel class metadata)
domain_inventory.justification: Provides verified geometric distance (4,520 NM vs 9,150 NM) and vessel compatibility constraints.

domain_inventory.source: Pelagos Macroeconomic Market Regime Definitions (Stage C1.3.2)
domain_inventory.available_routes_or_locations: Global maritime grain trade (applied to both PNW and USG corridors)
domain_inventory.alignment_feasibility: Feasible (Origin date t deterministically classified without lookahead bias)
domain_inventory.usability_status: Usable (Regime binary flags and categorical codes)
domain_inventory.justification: Standardized analytical segments (Pre-Supercycle, Peak/Crash, Post-Supercycle, Pandemic Disruption) documented under C1.3.2.

domain_inventory.available_routes_or_locations: Simultaneous USG and PNW grain export corridors to Japan
domain_inventory.alignment_feasibility: Feasible (Contemporaneous and lagged competitor rates available at origin t)
domain_inventory.usability_status: Usable (Competitor lag-0/lag-1, corridor spread lag-0, spread MA-3)
domain_inventory.justification: Defensible economic relationship: US Gulf and PNW grain elevators directly compete for Japanese grain import tenders.

excluded_external_domains.reason: Covers only Oct-Dec 2024 (8 USDA FAS GATS + 5 Indian DGCI&S); 1996-Sept 2024 absent.
excluded_external_domains.future_data_requirement: Multi-decade monthly bilateral bulk grain export volume archive (1996-present) aligned to post-month-end release dates.

excluded_external_domains.reason: Isolated moored-buoy snapshots (46041: 6, 42001: 5, AD01: 2) in Oct 2024 and Oct 2026.
excluded_external_domains.future_data_requirement: Continuous monthly aggregated North Pacific & Gulf weather/wave indices over 1996-present.

excluded_external_domains.reason: Only 5 single-day spot quotes (2026-11-06) at ARBUE/DKSKA; core corridor ports (Seattle, Houston, Tokyo Bay) UNAVAILABLE.
excluded_external_domains.future_data_requirement: Authentic historical monthly VLSFO/IFO380 bunker series for Pacific Northwest, U.S. Gulf, and Japanese hubs.

excluded_external_domains.reason: Single historical 48h/10s coastal AIS sample (2024-01-01/Oct 2024); zero multi-year congestion time series.
excluded_external_domains.future_data_requirement: Multi-year monthly port-congestion / bulk carrier queue-time indices for PNW and USG terminals.
